CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_sri(scanresolmm_val numeric, pointdense_val numeric)
RETURNS numeric AS $$
    SELECT CASE 
        WHEN scanresolmm_val IS NULL OR pointdense_val IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN scanresolmm_val <= 0 OR pointdense_val <= 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (LOG(scanresolmm_val * 1000) / LOG(10)) / (LOG(pointdense_val) / LOG(10)) * 5
    END;
$$ LANGUAGE SQL IMMUTABLE;
